title: Can I LEARN 1. e4 in 24 Hours?
summary: London-player learns 1.e4 (the Ruy Lopez, 59 lines) in 24 hours on chessreps, practises lines and puzzles, plays an arena bot, then wins a game with the Ruy Lopez and reviews it with the engine.
rules: Normal chess from 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 (Ruy Lopez).

opponent.name: Human opponent (rating not stated) / chessreps arena bot

board.theme_notes: chessreps brown board; confetti on line completion.

current_impl_issues: Forced 1.e4 opening vs bot approximates it; Ruy Lopez (3.Bb5) would be more faithful. No variant.
evidence: Transcript 0:01 'learn one E4 in 24 hours, and then try to win a game with E4'; 0:40 'Roy Lopez which has 59 lines'; 'puzzles which come directly from Roy Lopez'; 'ranked game against a bot'; end 'we do win our very first game ever playing the Roy Lopez'. Frames (visual_d): chessreps brown board, confetti.
not_playable_reason: Opening-study video (chessreps sponsor): learns the Ruy Lopez (59 lines) for 1.e4 in 24h, drills it, does Ruy Lopez puzzles, plays a ranked arena bot game, then wins his first real game with the Ruy Lopez. Normal chess.
